In his adventures in the often strangely beautiful, sometimes dangerous, and sometimes surprisingly familiar Malacandra and its inhabitants, Ransom uncovers information about the larger universe and Earth's place that suggest he has as much to discover about his home planet as he does about the alien Malacandra.

books.title: The Case-Book of Sherlock Holmes
books.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
books.desc:
The Illustrious Client
The Blanched Soldier
The Adventure Of The Mazarin Stone
The Adventure of the Three Gables
The Adventure of the Sussex Vampire
The Adventure of the Three Garridebs
The Problem of Thor Bridge
The Adventure of the Creeping Man
The Adventure of the Lion's Mane
The Adventure of the Veiled Lodger
The Adventure of Shoscombe Old Place
The Adventure of the Retired Colourman

books.title: King Solomon's Mines
books.author: H. Rider Haggard
books.desc:
King Solomon’s Mines was published in September 1885, becoming an immediate best seller by tapping into people’s excitement for the unknown: in this case, the unexplored regions of Africa.

Haggard wrote the novel in a very short period, between six and sixteen months, on a bet with his brother to try to match Robert Louis Stevenson’s Treasure Island. In the process he created a new literary genre known as the “Lost World” genre, which would later influence other writers like Arthur Conan Doyle and H. P. Lovecraft.

The book tells the tale of Allan Quatermain, an adventurer and hunter, who is approached by Sir Henry Curtis and Captain Good to help them find Curtis’ lost brother, who went missing while trying to find the fabled King Solomon’s Mines.

This book has spawned multiple adaptations in the form of movies, comics, and TV shows.

books.title: The Mystery of the Blue Train
books.author: Agatha Christie
books.desc: Bound for the Riviera, detective Hercule Poirot has boarded Le Train Bleu, an elegant, leisurely means of travel, free of intrigue. Then he meets Ruth Kettering. The American heiress bailing out of a doomed marriage is en route to reconcile with her former lover. But by morning, her private affairs are made public when she is found murdered in her luxury compartment. The rumour of a strange man loitering in the victim's shadow is all Poirot has to go on. Until Mrs. Kettering's secret life begins to unfold...

books.title: The Man Who Was Thursday
books.author: Gilbert Keith Chesterton
books.desc: Can you trust yourself when you don't know who you are? In a park in London, secret policeman Gabriel Syme strikes up a conversation with an anarchist. Sworn to do his duty, Syme uses his new acquaintance to go undercover in Europe's Central Anarchist Council and infiltrate their deadly mission, even managing to have himself voted to the position of 'Thursday'. When Syme discovers another undercover policeman on the Council, however, he starts to question his role in their operations. And as a desperate chase across Europe begins, his confusion grows, as well as his confidence in his ability to outwit his enemies. But he has still to face the greatest terror that the Council has: a man named Sunday, whose true nature is worse than Syme could ever have imagined...

books.title: 羊をめぐる冒険
books.author: 村上春樹
books.desc: It begins simply enough: A twenty-something advertising executive receives a postcard from a friend, and casually appropriates the image for an insurance company's advertisement. What he doesn't realize is that included in the pastoral scene is a mutant sheep with a star on its back, and in using this photo he has unwittingly captured the attention of a man in black who offers a menacing ultimatum: find the sheep or face dire consequences. Thus begins a surreal and elaborate quest that takes our hero from the urban haunts of Tokyo to the remote and snowy mountains of northern Japan, where he confronts not only the mythological sheep, but the confines of tradition and the demons deep within himself.

books.title: Cress
books.author: Marissa Meyer
books.desc:
In this third book in the Lunar Chronicles, Cinder and Captain Thorne are fugitives on the run, now with Scarlet and Wolf in tow. Together, they're plotting to overthrow Queen Levana and her army.

Their best hope lies with Cress, a girl imprisoned on a satellite since childhood who's only ever had her netscreens as company. All that screen time has made Cress an excellent hacker. Unfortunately, she's just received orders from Levana to track down Cinder and her handsome accomplice.

When a daring rescue of Cress goes awry, the group is separated. Cress finally has her freedom, but it comes at a higher price. Meanwhile, Queen Levana will let nothing prevent her marriage to Emperor Kai. Cress, Scarlet, and Cinder may not have signed up to save the world, but they may be the only hope the world has.

books.title: Dragonsong
books.author: Anne McCaffrey
books.desc: Menolly, a young fisher's daughter, had dreamed all her life of learning the Harper's craft. Her musical talent is not valued in her fishing hold, especially by her parents the holders, as women in general tend to be less valued and have fewer choices than men in Pernese society. When her father denies her what she regards to be her destiny, she flees Half Circle Hold just as Pern is struck by the deadly danger of Threadfall, a deathly rain that falls from the sky. Menolly takes shelter in a cave by the sea and there, she makes a miraculous discovery that will change her life.

books.title: Scythe
books.author: Neal Shusterman
books.desc:
*Thou shalt kill.*

A world with no hunger, no disease, no war, no misery. Humanity has conquered all those things, and has even conquered death. Now scythes are the only ones who can end life—and they are commanded to do so, in order to keep the size of the population under control.

Citra and Rowan are chosen to apprentice to a scythe—a role that neither wants. These teens must master the “art” of taking life, knowing that the consequence of failure could mean losing their own. 

(Description from GoodReads)

books.title: Star Wars - Thrawn Trilogy - Heir to the Empire
books.author: Timothy Zahn
books.desc:
It's five years after Return of the Jedi: the Rebel Alliance has destroyed the Death Star, defeated Darth Vader and the Emperor, and driven out the remnants of the old Imperial Starfleet to a distant corner of the galaxy. Princess Leia and Han Solo are married and expecting Jedi Twins. And Luke Skywalker has become the first in a long-awaited line of Jedi Knights. 

But thousand of light-years away, the last of the emperor's warlords has taken command of the shattered Imperial Fleet, readied it for war, and pointed it at the fragile heart of the new Republic. For this dark warrior has made two vital discoveries that could destroy everything the courageous men and women of the Rebel Alliance fought so hard to build. The explosive confrontation that results is a towering epic of action, invention, mystery, and spectacle on a galactic scale--in short, a story worthy of the name Star Wars.

books.title: From the Mixed-Up Files of Mrs. Basil E. Frankweiler
books.author: E. L. Konigsburg
books.desc: Having run away with her younger brother to live in the Metropolitan Museum of Art, twelve-year-old Claudia strives to keep things in order in their new home and to become a changed person and a heroine to herself.

books.title: Cat Kid Comic Club
books.author: Dav Pilkey
books.desc:
A pioneering new graphic novel series by Dav Pilkey, the author and illustrator of the internationally bestselling Dog Man and Captain Underpants series.
Naomi, Melvin, Pedro, and Poppy are just a few of the twenty-one rambunctious, funny, and talented baby frogs who share their stories in the Cat Kid Comic Club. Can Li'l Petey, Molly, and Flippy help the students express themselves through comics? The adventures in class and on paper unwind with mishaps and hilarity as the creative baby frogs experience the mistakes and progress that come with practice and persistence.

"Squid Kid and Katydid," "Baby Frog Squad," "Monster Cheese Sandwich," "Birds Flowers Trees: A Haiku Photo Comic," and other mini-comics are featured as stories-within-the-story, each done in a different style, utilizing humor and drama, prose and poetry, illustrated in different media including acrylics, pastels, colored pencils, felt-tip markers, clay, hand-made cardboard sculptures, photographs, pipe cleaners, construction paper collages, and cookies.

This heartfelt, humorous, and thoughtful graphic novel by award-winning author and artist Dav Pilkey will have readers of all ages laughing and motivated to unleash their own creativity.

books.title: Clockwork Angel
books.author: Cassandra Clare
books.desc: When Tessa Gray crosses the ocean to find her brother in Victorian England, something terrifying is waiting for her in London's Downworld. Kidnapped by the mysterious Dark sisters, who are members of a secret organization called the Pandemonium club, Tessa soon learns that she has the power to transform into another person. The Magister, the shadowy figure who runs the club, will stop at nothing to claim Tessa's power for his own. Friendless and hunted, Tessa takes refuge with the Shadowhunters, warriors dedicated to ridding the world of demons. She soon finds herself fascinated by--and torn between--two best friends: James and Will. As Tessa is drawn deep into a plot that threatens to destroy the Shadowhunters, she realizes that she may need to choose between saving her brother and helping her new friends save the world...and that love may be the most dangerous magic of all. [cover]

books.title: Scary stories to tell in the dark
books.author: Alvin Schwartz
books.desc: Stories of ghosts and witches, "jump" stories, scary songs, and modern-day scary stories.

books.title: The Silver Chair
books.author: C. S. Lewis
books.desc: Jill and Eustace must rescue the Prince from the evil Witch.

books.title: The Book Of Three
books.author: Lloyd Alexander
books.desc:
Taran is bored with his Assistant Pig-Keeper duties, even though his charge is none other than Hen Wen, Prydain's only oracular pig. He'd rather be doing something more heroic, like making swords and learning to use them. When Hen Wen escapes and Taran goes after her, he finds himself farther from home than he's ever been. Soon he begins to realize that heroism is no easy task. With the dreaded Horn King on the loose and King Arawn gathering the forces of evil, Taran must look past his own dreams to warn the population of Prydain before it's too late. - Back cover.

Taran, Assistant Pig-Keeper to a famous oracular sow, sets out on a hazardous mission to save Prydain from the forces of evil.

books.title: The Day the Crayons Quit
books.author: Drew Daywalt
books.desc: Poor Duncan just wants to color. But when he opens his box of crayons, he finds only letters, all saying the same thing: His crayons have had enough! They quit! Beige Crayon is tired of playing second fiddle to Brown Crayon. Black wants to be used for more than just outlining. Blue needs a break from coloring all those bodies of water. And Orange and Yellow are no longer speaking -- each believes he is the true color of the sun. What can Duncan possibly do to appease all of the crayons and get them back to doing what they do best? -- Publisher.

books.title: Big Nate Blasts Off!
books.author: Lincoln Peirce
books.desc: After his fight with Randy Betancourt makes headlines in the school paper, Big Nate has a problem worse than detention on his hands.

books.title: The Wee Free Men
books.author: Terry Pratchett
books.desc: A riotous, wise, and gripping junior Discworld novel from the Carnegie Medal-winning author and acknowledged master of comic fantasy.Nine-year-old Tiffany Aching thinks her Granny Aching - a wise shepherd - might have been a witch, but now Granny Aching is dead and it's up to Tiffany to work it all out when strange things begin happening: a fairy-tale monster in the stream, a headless horseman and, strangest of all, the tiny blue men in kilts, the Wee Free Men, who have come looking for the new 'hag'. These are the Nac Mac Feegles, the pictsies, who like nothing better than thievin', fightin' and drinkin'. Then Tiffany's young brother goes missing and Tiffany and the Wee Free Men must join forces to save him from the Queen of the Fairies-

books.title: Anne of Avonlea
books.author: Lucy Maud Montgomery
books.desc: The second story in the ever-popular Anne of Green Gables series.Now Anne is half past sixteen and she's ready to begin a new life teaching in her old school. She's as feisty as ever and is fiercely determined to inspire young hearts with her own ambitions. But some of her pupils are as boisterous and high-spirited as Anne, and so life in her Avonlea classroom becomes a lesson in discovery and adventure . . .

books.title: さびしすぎてレズ風俗に行きましたレポ
books.author: Kabi Nagata
books.desc: The heart-rending autobiographical manga that's taken the internet by storm! My Lesbian Experience with Loneliness is an honest and heartfelt look at one young woman's exploration of her sexuality, mental well-being, and growing up in our modern age. Told using expressive artwork that invokes both laughter and tears, this moving and highly entertaining single volume depicts not only the artist's burgeoning sexuality, but many other personal aspects of her life that will resonate with readers.

books.title: Daring Greatly
books.author: Brené Brown
books.desc:
Based on twelve years of research, thought leader Dr. Brené Brown argues that vulnerability is not weakness, but rather our clearest path to courage, engagement, and meaningful connection.

"Every day we experience the uncertainty, risks, and emotional exposure that define what it means to be vulnerable, or to dare greatly. Whether the arena is a new relationship, an important meeting, our creative process, or a difficult family conversation, we must find the courage to walk into vulnerability and engage with our whole hearts. In Daring Greatly, Dr. Brown challenges everything we think we know about vulnerability. Based on twelve years of research, she argues that vulnerability is not weakness, but rather our clearest path to courage, engagement, and meaningful connection. The book that Dr. Brown's many fans have been waiting for, Daring Greatly will spark a new spirit of truth--and trust--in our organizations, families, schools, and communities." -- Publisher's description.

books.title: The Mythical Man-Month
books.author: Frederick P. Brooks
books.desc: Classic text on the human side of software engineering, containing essays on the management of software teams, projections about how computer languages and tools will evolve, and philosophical speculation. Unlike most other books about computing, Brooks' work has been remarkably enduring, remaining in print for at least four decades. The book is most famous for its statement of Brooks' Law: "adding manpower to a late software project makes it later".

books.title: The Wealth of Nations
books.author: Adam Smith
books.desc: Adam Smith's The Wealth of Nations was recognized as a landmark of human thought upon its publication in 1776. As the first scientific argument for the principles of political economy, it is the point of departure for all subsequent economic thought. Smith's theories of capital accumulation, growth, and secular change, among others, continue to be influential in modern economics. This reprint of Edwin Cannan's definitive 1904 edition of The Wealth of Nations includes Cannan's famous introduction, notes, and a full index, as well as a new preface written especially for this edition by the distinguished economist George J. Stigler. Mr. Stigler's preface will be of value for anyone wishing to see the contemporary relevance of Adam Smith's thought.

books.title: The millionaire next door
books.author: Thomas J. Stanley
books.desc: Can you spot the millionaire next door? Who are the rich in this country? What do they do? Where do they shop? What do they drive? How do they invest? Where did their ancestors come from? How did they get rich? Can I ever become one of them? Get the answers in The Millionaire Next Door, the never-before-told story about wealth in America. You'll be surprised at what you find out. "Why aren't I as wealthy as I should be?" Many people ask this question of themselves all the time. Often they are hard-working, well-educated, middle-to-high-income people. Why, then, are so few affluent? The answer lies in The Millionaire Next Door: The Surprising Secrets of America's wealthy. According to authors Thomas J. Stanley and William D. Danko, most people have it all wrong about how you become wealthy in America. It is seldom inheritance or advanced degrees or even intelligence that builds fortunes in this country. Wealth in America is more often the result of hard work, diligent savings, and living below your means. - Jacket.

books.title: Animal Farm / Nineteen Eighty-Four
books.author: George Orwell
books.desc:
Contains:

- Animal Farm
- [Nineteen Eighty-Four](https://openlibrary.org/works/OL1168091W/Nineteen_Eighty-Four)

books.title: Memories of ice
books.author: Steven Erikson
books.desc: The thrilling third volume in Steven Erikson's epic fantasy sequence, The Malazan Book of the Fallen.The ravaged continent of Genabackis has given birth to a terrifying new empire: the Pannion Domin. Like a fanatical tide of corrupted blood, it seethes across the land, devouring all who fail to heed the Word of its elusive prophet, the Pannion Seer. In its path stands an uneasy alliance: Dujek Onearm's Host and the Bridgeburners ­ each now outlawed by the Empress ­ alongside their enemies of old including the grim forces of Warlord Caladan Brood, Anomander Rake, Son of Darkness, and his Tiste Andii, and the Rhivi people of the Plains.But more ancient clans too are gathering. As if in answer to some primal summons, the massed ranks of the undead T'lan Imass have risen. For it would seem something altogether darker and more malign threatens the very substance of this world. The Warrens are poisoned and rumours abound of the Crippled God, now unchained and intent on a terrible revenge...Marking the return of many favourite characters from GARDENS OF THE MOON and introducing a host of remarkable new players, MEMORIES OF ICE is a thrilling new chapter in Erikson's magnificent epic fantasy and another triumph of storytelling.

books.title: The Amazing Adventures of Kavalier & Clay
books.title_zh: 卡瓦利尔与克莱的奇异冒险
books.author: Michael Chabon
books.desc:
The novel begins in 1939 with the arrival of 19-year-old Josef "Joe" Kavalier as a refugee in New York City, where he comes to live with his 17-year-old cousin Sammy Klayman. Joe escaped from Prague with the help of his teacher Kornblum by hiding in a coffin along with the inanimate Golem of Prague, leaving the rest of his family, including his younger brother Thomas, behind. Besides having a shared interest in drawing, Sammy and Joe share several connections to Jewish stage magician Harry Houdini: Joe (like comics legend Jim Steranko) studied magic and escapology in Prague, which aided him in his departure from Europe, and Sammy is the son of the Mighty Molecule, a strongman on the vaudeville circuit.

When Sammy discovers Joe's artistic talent, Sammy gets Joe a job as an illustrator for a novelty products company, which, due to the recent success of Superman, is attempting to get into the comic-book business. Under the name "Sam Clay", Sammy starts writing adventure stories with Joe illustrating them, and the two recruit several other Brooklyn teenagers to produce Amazing Midget Radio Comics (named to promote one of the company's novelty items). The pair is at once passionate about their creation, optimistic about making money, and always nervous about the opinion of their employers. The magazine features Sammy and Joe's character the Escapist, an anti-fascist superhero who combines traits of (among others) Captain America, Harry Houdini, Batman, the Phantom, and the Scarlet Pimpernel. The Escapist becomes tremendously popular, but like talent behind Superman, the writers and artists of the comic get a minimal share of their publisher's revenue. Sammy and Joe are slow to realize that they are being exploited, as they have private concerns: Joe is trying to help his family escape from Nazi-occupied Prague, and has fallen in love with the bohemian Rosa Saks, who has her own artistic aspirations, while Clay is battling with his sexual identity and the lackluster progress of his literary career.

For many months after coming to New York, Joe is driven almost solely by an intense desire to improve the condition of his family, still living under a regime increasingly hostile to their kind. This drive shows through in his work, which remains for a long time unabashedly anti-Nazi despite his employer's concerns. In the meantime, he is spending more and more time with Rosa, appearing as a magician in the bar mitzvahs of the children of Rosa's father's acquaintances, even though he sometimes feels guilty at indulging in these distractions from the primary task of fighting for his family. After multiple attempts and considerable monetary sacrifice, Joe ultimately fails to get his family to the States, his last attempt having resulted in putting his younger brother aboard a ship that sank into the Atlantic. Distraught and unaware that Rosa is pregnant with his child, Joe enlists in the navy, hoping to fight the Germans. Instead, he is sent to a lonely, cold naval base in Antarctica, from which he emerges the lone survivor after a series of deaths. When he makes it back to New York, ashamed to show his face again to Rosa and Sammy, he lives and sleeps in a hideout in the Empire State Building, known only to a small circle of magician-friends.

Meanwhile, Sam battles with his sexuality, shown mostly through his relationship with the radio voice of The Escapist, Tracy Bacon. Bacon's movie-star good-looks initially intimidate Clay, but they later fall in love. When Tracy is cast as The Escapist in the film version, he invites Clay to move to Hollywood with him, an offer that Clay accepts. But later, when Bacon and Clay go to a friend's beach house with several other gay men and couples, the company's private dinner is broken up by the local police as well as two off-duty FBI agents. All of the men are arrested, except for two who hid under the dinner table, one of whom is Clay. The FBI agents each claim one of the men and grant them their freedom in return for sexual favors. After this episode, Clay decides that he can't live with the constant threat of being arrested, ridiculed, and judged because of his sexuality. He does not go with Bacon to the West Coast. Some time after Joe leaves, Sammy marries Rosa and moves with her to the suburbs, where they raise her son Tommy in what outwardly appears to be a typical traditional nuclear family.

Sammy and Rosa cannot hide all their secrets from Tommy, however, who manages to take private magic lessons in the Empire State Building from Joe for the better part of year without anyone else's knowledge. Tommy is instrumental in finally reuniting the Kavalier and Clay duo, which works with renewed enthusiasm to find a new creative direction for comics. Joe moves into Sammy and Rosa's house. Shortly afterwards, Sammy's homosexuality is revealed on public television. This further complicates the attempts of Rosa, Sammy, and Joe to reconstitute a family.

Many events in the novel are based on the lives of actual comic-book creators including Jack Kirby (to whom the book is dedicated in the afterword), Stan Lee, Jerry Siegel, Joe Shuster, Joe Simon, Will Eisner, and Jim Steranko. Other historical figures play minor roles, including Salvador Dalí, Al Smith, Orson Welles, and Fredric Wertham. The novel's time span roughly mirrors that of the Golden Age of Comics itself, starting from shortly after the debut of Superman and concluding with the Kefauver Senate hearings, two events often used to demarcate the era.

books.title: The Visual Display of Quantitative Information
books.author: Edward R. Tufte
books.desc: The classic book on statistical graphics, charts, tables. Theory and practice in the design of data graphics, 250 illustrations of the best (and a few of the worst) statistical graphics, with detailed analysis of how to display data for precise, effective, quick analysis. Design of the high-resolution displays, small multiples. Editing and improving graphics. The data-ink ratio. Time-series, relational graphics, data maps, multivariate designs. Detection of graphical deception: design variation vs. data variation. Sources of deception. Aesthetics and data graphical displays. This is the second edition of The Visual Display of Quantitative Information. Recently published, this new edition provides excellent color reproductions of the many graphics of William Playfair, adds color to other images, and includes all the changes and corrections accumulated during 17 printings of the first edition.

books.title: Brief Lives
books.author: Neil Gaiman
books.desc: An attempt to summon and imprison Death, results, instead, in the capture of Morpheus, the Sandman, who must regain the tools of his powers.

books.title: Attack of the Deranged Mutant Killer Monster Snow Goons
books.author: Bill Watterson
books.desc: With the help of his faithful stuffed tiger companion and his alter egos--Spaceman Spiff, Stupendous Man, and Tracer Bullet--Calvin continues to navigate the tricky waters of youth.

books.title: Dog Man Unleashed
books.author: Dav Pilkey
books.desc:
**Petey is up to no good in the second Dog Man book from worldwide bestselling author and artist Dav Pilkey.**

Dog Man is still learning a few tricks of the trade. Petey the Cat is out of the bag, and his criminal curiosity is taking the city by storm. Something fishy is going on! Can Dog Man unleash justice on this ruffian in time to save the city, or will Petey get away with the purr-fect crime?

Dav Pilkey's wildly popular Dog Man series appeals to readers of all ages and explores universally positive themes, including empathy, kindness, persistence, and the importance of being true to one's self.

books.title: Nick and Charlie
books.author: Alice Oseman
books.desc:
From the mega-bestselling creator of Heartstopper, a must-have novella in which Heartstopper's lead characters, Nick and Charlie, face one of their biggest challenges yet.

Absence makes the heart grow fonder... right?

Everyone knows that Nick and Charlie love their nearly inseparable life together. But soon Nick will be leaving for university, and Charlie, a year younger, will be left behind. Everyone's asking if they're staying together, which is a stupid question... or at least that's what Nick and Charlie assume at first.

As the time to say goodbye gets inevitably closer, both Nick and Charlie start to question whether their love is strong enough to survive being apart. Charlie is sure he's holding Nick back... and Nick can't tell what Charlie's thinking.

Things spiral from there.

Everyone knows that first loves rarely last forever. What will it take for Nick and Charlie to defy the odds?

books.title: De la terre à la lune
books.author: Jules Verne
books.desc: Novela grafica

books.title: The Starless Sea
books.author: Erin Morgenstern
books.desc:
**FAR BENEATH** the surface of the earth, upon the shores of the Starless Sea, there is a labyrinthine collection of tunnels and rooms filled with stories. The entryways that lead to this sanctuary are often hidden, sometimes on forest floors, sometimes in private homes, sometimes in plain sight. But those who seek will find. Their doors have been waiting for them.

Zachary Ezra Rawlins is searching for his door, though he does not know it. He follows a silent siren song, an inexplicable certainty that he is meant for another place. When he discovers a mysterious book in the stacks of his campus library, he begins to read and is entranced by tales of lovelorn prisoners, lost cities, and nameless acolytes. Suddenly, a turn of the page brings Zachary to a story from his own childhood, impossibly written in this book that is older than he is.

A bee, a key, and a sword emblazoned on the book lead Zachary to two people who will change the course of his life: Mirabel, a fierce, pink-haired painter, and Dorian, a handsome, barefoot man with shifting alliances. These strangers guide Zachary through masquerade-party dances and whispered backroom stories to the headquarters of a secret society, where doorknobs hang from ribbons, and finally through a door conjured from paint to the place he has always yearned for.

Amid twisting tunnels filled with books, gilded ballrooms, and wine-dark shores, Zachary falls into an intoxicating world soaked in romance and mystery. But a battle is raging over the fate of this place, and though there are those who would willingly sacrifice everything to protect it, there are just as many intent on its destruction. As Zachary, Mirabel, and Dorian venture deeper into the space and its histories and myths, searching for answer and one another, a timeless love story unspools, casting a spell of pirates, painters, lovers, liars, and ships that sail upon a Starless Sea.

This description comes from the publisher.

books.title: My sister, the serial killer
books.author: Oyinkan Braithwaite
books.desc:
"Satire meets slasher in this short, darkly funny hand grenade of a novel about a Nigerian woman whose younger sister has a very inconvenient habit of killing her boyfriends. "Femi makes three, you know. Three and they label you a serial killer." Korede is bitter. How could she not be? Her sister, Ayoola, is many things: the favorite child, the beautiful one, possibly sociopathic. And now Ayoola's third boyfriend in a row is dead. Korede's practicality is the sisters' saving grace. She knows the best solutions for cleaning blood, the trunk of her car is big enough for a body, and she keeps Ayoola from posting pictures of her dinner to Instagram when she should be mourning her "missing" boyfriend. Not that she gets any credit. A kind, handsome doctor at the hospital where Korede works is the bright spot in her life. She dreams of the day when he will realize they're perfect for each other. But one day Ayoola shows up to the hospital uninvited and he takes notice. When he asks Korede for Ayoola's phone number, she must reckon with what her sister has become and what she will do about it. Sharp as nails and full of deadpan wit, Oyinkan Braithwaite has written a deliciously deadly debut that's as fun as it is frightening"--

"Slasher meets satire, in this darkly comic novel set in Nigeria about a woman whose younger sister has a very inconvenient habit of killing her boyfriends"--

books.title: John Dies at the End
books.author: David Wong
books.desc: This may be the story of John and David, a drug called soy sauce, and other-worldly beings invading the planet. Or, it may be the story of two beer-drinking friends who live in an unnamed Midwestern town and only think something horrific is going on. But the important thing is, according to the narrator, "None of this is my fault."

books.title: The Murder at the Vicarage
books.author: Agatha Christie
books.desc:
***Murder at the Vicarage (1930)is the first Miss Marple mystery book by Agatha Christie.***  Miss Jane Marple is a village busybody who applies human nature to crimes. Colonel Protheroe, magistrate universally despised, was shot in his study, unheard. His wife Anne admits newly arrived artist Lawrence Redding is an old flame, and both confess to murder. **The local inspector and Miss Marple sort through to the truth.**

***The murder of Colonel Protheroe shocks the town of St. Mary Mead, where the main entertainment is tea and gossip.*** Among the neighbors of St. Mary Mead, the most meddlesome, observant and shrewd person is Miss Marple. His intervention will be decisive in the resolution of a crime for which there are no suspects.

***Death in the vicarage, published in 1930, was the first appearance of one of the most important characters in the work of Agatha Christie, the spinster and insightful Miss Marple, whose cases have been adapted several times both to the cinema and in Form of television series.***

books.title: His Last Bow [8 stories]
books.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
books.desc: The adventure of Wisteria lodge.--The adventure of the cardboard box.--The adventure of the red circle.--The adventure of the Bruce-Partington plans.--The adventure of the dying detective.--The disappearance of Lady Frances Carfax.--The adventure of the devil's foot.--His last bow.

books.title: Beyond the Shadows
books.author: Brent Weeks
books.desc:
A new queen has usurped the throne and is leading Cenaria into disaster. The country has become a broken realm with a threadbare army, little food, and no hope. Kylar Stern plans to reinstate his closest friend Logan as King, but can he really get away with murder?
In the north, the Godking's death has thrown Khalidor into civil war. To gain the upper hand, one faction attempts to raise the goddess Khali herself. But they are playing with volatile powers, and trigger conflict on a vast scale. Seven armies will converge to save - or destroy - an entire continent.
Kylar has finally learnt the bitter cost of immortality, and is faced with a task only he can complete. To save his friends, and perhaps his enemies, he must assassinate a goddess. Failure will doom the south. Success will cost him everything he's ever loved.

books.title: Men Explain Things To Me
books.author: Rebecca Solnit
books.desc: In her comic, scathing essay "Men Explain Things to Me," Rebecca Solnit took on what often goes wrong in conversations between men and women. She wrote about men who wrongly assume they know things and wrongly assume women don't, about why this arises, and how this aspect of the gender wars works, airing some of her own hilariously awful encounters. She ends on a serious note-- because the ultimate problem is the silencing of women who have something to say, including those saying things like, "He's trying to kill me!" This book features that now-classic essay with six perfect complements, including an examination of the great feminist writer Virginia Woolf 's embrace of mystery, of not knowing, of doubt and ambiguity, a highly original inquiry into marriage equality, and a terrifying survey of the scope of contemporary violence against women

books.title: Una cascata di cioccolato
books.author: Elisabetta Dami
books.desc: When the Thea Sisters are invited to a chocolate factory in Ecuador. Someone is trying to sabotage the chocolate factory while during a competition. This is an excellent book written by Elisabetta Dami in the real world and published by Scholastic.

books.title: The Price of Salt
books.author: Patricia Highsmith
books.desc: THE PRICE OF SALT is the famous lesbian love story by Patricia Highsmith, written under the pseudonym Claire Morgan. The author became notorious due to the story's latent lesbian content and happy ending, the latter having been unprecedented in homosexual fiction. Highsmith recalled that the novel was inspired by a mysterious woman she happened across in a shop and briefly stalked. Because of the happy ending (or at least an ending with the possibility of happiness) which defied the lesbian pulp formula and because of the unconventional characters that defied stereotypes about homosexuality, THE PRICE OF SALT was popular among lesbians in the 1950s. The book fell out of print but was re-issued and lives on today as a pioneering work of lesbian romance.

books.title: Harrow the Ninth
books.author: Tamsyn Muir
books.desc:
"She answered the Emperor's call.

She arrived with her arts, her wits, and her only friend.

In victory, her world has turned to ash.

After rocking the cosmos with her deathly debut, Tamsyn Muir continues the story of the penumbral Ninth House in Harrow the Ninth, a mind-twisting puzzle box of mystery, murder, magic, and mayhem. Nothing is as it seems in the halls of the Emperor, and the fate of the galaxy rests on one woman's shoulders.

Harrowhark Nonagesimus, last necromancer of the Ninth House, has been drafted by her Emperor to fight an unwinnable war. Side-by-side with a detested rival, Harrow must perfect her skills and become an angel of undeath ― but her health is failing, her sword makes her nauseous, and even her mind is threatening to betray her.

Sealed in the gothic gloom of the Emperor's Mithraeum with three unfriendly teachers, hunted by the mad ghost of a murdered planet, Harrow must confront two unwelcome questions: is somebody trying to kill her? And if they succeeded, would the universe be better off?"

books.title: The Reptile Room
books.author: Lemony Snicket
books.desc: Book 2 of A Series of Unfortunate Events. The three unluckiest children in the world return for another misfortunate adventure. The Baudelaire children survived their first encounter with the dastardly and scheming Olaf, but the Count doesn't give up easily. Nor does the Baudelaire luck ever seem to improve.

books.title: Les trois Mousquetaires
books.author: Alexandre Dumas
books.desc: During the reign of France's King Louis XIV, D'Artagnan and three musketeers unite to defend the honor of Anne of Austria against the plots of Cardinal Richeliu.

books.title: Robinson Crusoe
books.author: Daniel Defoe
books.desc: During one of his several adventurous voyages in the 1600's, an Englishman becomes the sole survivor of a shipwreck and lives for nearly thirty years on a deserted island.

books.title: Sadako and the Thousand Paper Cranes
books.author: Eleanor Coerr
books.desc: Hiroshima-born Sadako is lively and athletic--the star of her school's running team. And then the dizzy spells start. Soon gravely ill with leukemia, the "atom bomb disease," Sadako faces her future with spirit and bravery. Recalling a Japanese legend, Sadako sets to work folding paper cranes. For the legend holds that if a sick person folds one thousand cranes, the gods will grant her wish and make her healthy again. Based on a true story, *Sadako and the Thousand Paper Cranes* celebrates the extraordinary courage that made one young woman a heroine in Japan

books.title: The Demigod Files
books.author: Rick Riordan
books.desc: In these top-secret files, Rick Riordan, Camp Half-Blood's senior scribe, gives you an inside look at the world of demigods that NO regular human child is allowed to see.These highly classified archives include three of Percy Jackson's most perilous adventures, a Spotter's Guide to Monsters, a Who's Who in Greek mythology, Percy's Summer Camp report and much more.So, if you're armed with this book, you'll have everything you need to know to keep you alive in your training. Your own adventures have just begun . . .

books.title: We Should All Be Feminists
books.author: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie
books.desc: In this essay -- adapted from her TEDx talk of the same name -- Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie, award-winning author of Americanah, offers readers a unique definition of feminism for the twenty-first century, one rooted in inclusion and awareness. Drawing extensively on her own experiences and her understanding of the often masked realities of sexual politics, here is one remarkable author's exploration of what it means to be a woman now -- and an of-the-moment rallying cry for why we should all be feminists.

books.title: Crucial Conversations
books.author: Kerry Patterson
books.desc: The New York Times Bestseller!Learn how to keep your cool and get the results you want when emotions flare.When stakes are high, opinions vary, and emotions run strong, you have three choices: Avoid a crucial conversation and suffer the consequences; handle the conversation badly and suffer the consequences; or read Crucial Conversations and discover how to communicate best when it matters most. Crucial Conversations gives you the tools you need to step up to life's most difficult and important conversations, say what's on your mind, and achieve the positive resolutions you want. You'll learn how to:Prepare for high-impact situations with a six-minute mastery techniqueMake it safe to talk about almost anythingBe persuasive, not abrasiveKeep listening when others blow up or clam upTurn crucial conversations into the action and results you wantWhether they take place at work or at home, with your neighbors or your spouse, crucial conversations can have a profound impact on your career, your happiness, and your future. With the skills you learn in this book, you'll never have to worry about the outcome of a crucial conversation again.

books.title: The science of getting rich, or, financial success through creative thought
books.author: Wallace D. Wattles
books.desc: As featured in the bestselling book The Secret, here is the landmark guide to wealth creation republished with the classic essay How to Get What You Want.Wallace D. Wattles spent a lifetime considering the laws of success as he found them in the work of the worlds great philosophers. He then turned his life effort into this simple, slender book  a volume that he vowed could replace libraries of philosophy, spirituality, and self-help for the purpose of attaining one definite goal: a life of prosperity.Wattles describes a definite science of wealth attraction, built on the foundation of one commanding idea: There is a thinking stuff from which all things are madeA thought, in this substance, produces the thing that is imaged by the thought.In his seventeen short, straight-to-the-point chapters, Wattles shows how to use this idea, how to overcome barriers to its application, and how work with very direct methods that awaken it in your life. He further explains how creation and not competition is the hidden key to wealth attraction, and how your power to get rich uplifts everyone around you.The Science of Getting Rich concludes with Wattles rare essay How to Get Want You Want  a brilliant refresher of his laws of wealth creation.

books.title: La Divina Commedia
books.author: Dante Alighieri
books.desc:
De goddelijke komedie is de beschrijving van een denkbeeldige tocht door het hiernamaals. Zij heeft drie delen: de hel, het vagevuur en het paradijs en ieder van deze delen heeft drieëndertig zangen van niet geheel gelijke lengte, terwijl aan het eerste deel nog een inleidende zang voorafgaat, waardoor het totale aantal van de zang honderd bedraagt. Dit aantal is geen toevalligheid. Het getal honderd gold in de middeleeuwse getallensymboliek, waarvan ook Dante een naarstig beoefenaar was, als het zinnebeeld van de volmaaktheid. Drie is het getal van de personen der heilige drie-eenheid, drieëndertig is het aantal jaren van Jezus' aardse leven. 

In de eerste zang van De goddelijke komedie is Dante verdwaald in een donker woud en terwijl hij wanhopig naar hulp uitziet ontmoet hij daar de Latijnse dichter Vergilius. Samen verlaten zij het aardoppervlak en dalen af naar de hel, die voorgesteld wordt als een systeem van concentrische, zich steeds verder vernauwende kringen, een soort geringde trechter, die tenslotte in het middelpunt van de aarde eindigt. Daar zit Lucifer in het ijs, met zijn hoofd naar ons halfrond toe en met zijn voeten naar het zuidelijk halfrond gekeerd. 

Tussen het ijs en Lucifer vinden Dante en Vergilius een weg langs het middelpunt van de aarde en stijgen dan weer op naar het zuidelijk halfrond. Zij bereiken een eiland, waar zich een hoge berg verheft, de louteringsberg van het vagevuur, waar de zielen die in staat van genade zijn gestorven, maar hun aardse schulden nog niet hebben uitgeboet, geleidelijk gelouterd worden en opstijgen naar de hemelse zaligheid. Deze berg, een soort tegenbeeld van de hel, heeft langs zijn flanken steeds nauwer wordende gaanderijen. Daarlangs stijgen Dante en Vergilius opwaarts naar de top, waar zich het aardse paradijs bevindt. 

Wanneer zij daar zijn aangekomen, wordt Vergilius als Dante's geleider afgelost door Beatrice. Samen met Beatrice stijgt Dante nu opwaarts naar het paradijs. De eeuwige woonplaats van de zaligen bestraald door het licht van God.

books.title: Prisoners of geography
books.author: Tim Marshall
books.desc: All leaders are constrained by geography. Their choices are limited by mountains, rivers, seas and concrete. Yes, to understand world events you need to understand people, ideas and movements - but if you don't know geography, you'll never have the full picture. To understand Putin's actions, for example, it is essential to consider that, to be a world power, Russia must have a navy. And if its ports freeze for six months each year then it must have access to a warm water port - hence, the annexation of Crimea was the only option for Putin. To understand the Middle East, it is crucial to know that geography is the reason why countries have logically been shaped as they are - and this is why invented countries (e.g. Syria, Iraq, Libya) will not survive as nation states. Spread over ten chapters (covering Russia; China; the USA; Latin America; the Middle East; Africa; India and Pakistan; Europe; Japan and Korea; and Greenland and the Arctic), using maps, essays and occasionally the personal experiences of the widely traveled author, Prisoners of Geography looks at the past, present and future to offer an essential guide to one of the major determining factors in world history.

books.title: The Salmon of Doubt
books.author: Douglas Adams
books.desc: On Friday, May 11, 2001, the world mourned the untimely passing of Douglas Adams, beloved creator of The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, dead of a heart attack at age forty-nine.  Thankfully, in addition to a magnificent literary legacy--which includes seven novels and three co-authored works of nonfiction--Douglas left us something more. The book you are about to enjoy was rescued from his four computers, culled from an archive of chapters from his long-awaited novel-in-progress, as well as his short stories, speeches, articles, interviews, and letters. In a way that none of his previous books could, The Salmon of Doubt provides the full, dazzling, laugh-out-loud experience of a journey through the galaxy as perceived by Douglas Adams. From a boy's first love letter (to his favorite science fiction magazine) to the distinction of possessing a nose of heroic proportions; from climbing Kilimanjaro in a rhino costume to explaining why Americans can't make a decent cup of tea; from lyrical tributes to the sublime pleasures found in music by Procol Harum, the Beatles, and Bach to the follies of his hopeless infatuation with technology; from fantastic, fictional forays into the private life of Genghis Khan to extended visits with Dirk Gently and Zaphod Beeblebrox: this is the vista from the elevated perch of one of the tallest, funniest, most brilliant, and most penetrating social critics and thinkers of our time.Welcome to the wonderful mind of Douglas Adams.From the Hardcover edition.

books.title: The Lottery
books.author: Shirley Jackson
books.desc:
Also contained in:

 - [Come Away with Me](https://openlibrary.org/works/OL3171081W/Come_Along_With_Me)
 - [Fifth Fontana Book of Great Horror Stories](https://openlibrary.org/works/OL15393309W/The_Fifth_Fontana_Book_of_Great_Horror_Stories)
 - [Great Short Stories of the World](https://openlibrary.org/works/OL16048288W/Great_Short_Stories_of_the_World)

 - [Scarlet Letter and Related Readings](https://openlibrary.org/works/OL455418W/Scarlet_Letter_and_Related_Readings)
 - [Scarlet Letter with Connections](https://openlibrary.org/works/OL455436W/Scarlet_Letter_with_Connections)

books.title: How to Lie with Statistics
books.author: Darrell Huff
books.desc: Both charming and informative about how statistics are misused.  Published long ago, but the tricks haven't changed.

books.title: Pale Blue Dot
books.author: Carl Sagan
books.desc:
“Fascinating . . . memorable . . . revealing . . . perhaps the best of Carl Sagan’s books.”—The Washington Post Book World (front page review)

In Cosmos, the late astronomer Carl Sagan cast his gaze over the magnificent mystery of the Universe and made it accessible to millions of people around the world. Now in this stunning sequel, Carl Sagan completes his revolutionary journey through space and time.

Future generations will look back on our epoch as the time when the human race finally broke into a radically new frontier—space. In Pale Blue Dot, Sagan traces the spellbinding history of our launch into the cosmos and assesses the future that looms before us as we move out into our own solar system and on to distant galaxies beyond. The exploration and eventual settlement of other worlds is neither a fantasy nor luxury, insists Sagan, but rather a necessary condition for the survival of the human race.

books.title: Behave
books.author: Robert M. Sapolsky
books.desc:
Why do we do the things we do?

Over a decade in the making, this game-changing book is Robert Sapolsky's genre-shattering attempt to answer that question as fully as perhaps only he could, looking at it from every angle. Sapolsky's storytelling concept is delightful but it also has a powerful intrinsic logic: he starts by looking at the factors that bear on a person's reaction in the precise moment a behavior occurs, and then hops back in time from there, in stages, ultimately ending up at the deep history of our species and its genetic inheritance.

And so the first category of explanation is the neurobiological one. What goes on in a person's brain a second before the behavior happens? Then he pulls out to a slightly larger field of vision, a little earlier in time: What sight, sound, or smell triggers the nervous system to produce that behavior? And then, what hormones act hours to days earlier to change how responsive that individual is to the stimuli which trigger the nervous system? By now, he has increased our field of vision so that we are thinking about neurobiology and the sensory world of our environment and endocrinology in trying to explain what happened.

Sapolsky keeps going--next to what features of the environment affected that person's brain, and then back to the childhood of the individual, and then to their genetic makeup. Finally, he expands the view to encompass factors larger than that one individual. How culture has shaped that individual's group, what ecological factors helped shape that culture, and on and on, back to evolutionary factors thousands and even millions of years old.

The result is one of the most dazzling tours de horizon of the science of human behavior ever attempted, a majestic synthesis that harvests cutting-edge research across a range of disciplines to provide a subtle and nuanced perspective on why we ultimately do the things we do...for good and for ill. Sapolsky builds on this understanding to wrestle with some of our deepest and thorniest questions relating to tribalism and xenophobia, hierarchy and competition, morality and free will, and war and peace. Wise, humane, often very funny, Behave is a towering achievement, powerfully humanizing, and downright heroic in its own right.

Source: Publisher

books.title: This is How You Lose the Time War
books.author: Amal El-Mohtar
books.desc:
Two time-traveling agents from warring futures, working their way through the past, begin to exchange letters—and fall in love in this thrilling and romantic book from award-winning authors Amal El-Mohtar and Max Gladstone.

In the ashes of a dying world, Red finds a letter marked “Burn before reading. Signed, Blue.”

So begins an unlikely correspondence between two rival agents in a war that stretches through the vast reaches of time and space.

Red belongs to the Agency, a post-singularity technotopia. Blue belongs to Garden, a single vast consciousness embedded in all organic matter. Their pasts are bloody and their futures mutually exclusive. They have nothing in common—save that they’re the best, and they’re alone.

Now what began as a battlefield boast grows into a dangerous game, one both Red and Blue are determined to win. Because winning’s what you do in war. Isn’t it?

A tour de force collaboration from two powerhouse writers that spans the whole of time and space.

books.desc: 理性沉稳的纳尔齐斯与感性放纵的歌尔德蒙，两条道路映照人生的两极，黑塞力作。

books.title: 情人
books.author: 玛格丽特·杜拉斯
books.desc: 少女与年长的中国情人在法属殖民地的禁忌之恋，杜拉斯关于欲望与记忆的告白。

books.title: 追忆似水年华
books.author: 马塞尔·普鲁斯特
books.desc: 以绵密意识流追忆童年、爱情与时光，普鲁斯特的皇皇巨著。

books.title: 丰乳肥臀
books.author: 莫言
books.desc: 母亲上官鲁氏含辛茹苦养育子女，在苦难中支撑家族，莫言笔下的女性与土地。

books.title: 檀香刑
books.author: 莫言
books.desc: 借“檀香刑”这一酷刑，写清末民间戏班与官府、反抗与牺牲，莫言的历史小说。

books.title: 生死疲劳
books.author: 莫言
books.desc: 地主西门闹经历六世轮回，见证半个世纪的乡村巨变，荒诞与深刻并存的魔幻之作。

books.title: 蛙
books.author: 莫言
books.desc: 乡村女医生万心大半生为接生奔忙，计划生育背景下的个体命运，莫言获诺奖前的重要作品。

books.title: 呐喊（纪念版）
books.author: 鲁迅
books.desc: 鲁迅《呐喊》纪念版，收录《狂人日记》等经典短篇。

books.title: 狂人日记
books.author: 鲁迅
books.desc: 借“狂人”之眼，看尽“吃人”的旧礼教，鲁迅第一篇白话小说，震聋发聩。

books.title: 彷徨（纪念版）
books.author: 鲁迅
books.desc: 鲁迅《彷徨》纪念版，收录《祝福》《伤逝》等作品。

books.title: 故事新编
books.author: 鲁迅
books.desc: 以神话和历史为素材的短篇小说集，收录《补天》《奔月》《铸剑》《理水》等八篇。古人血肉丰满，古今交融，充满反讽与幽默。

books.title: 野草
books.author: 鲁迅
books.desc: 鲁迅散文诗集，二十三篇短小精悍的哲思之作。'于浩歌狂热之际中寒，于天上看见深渊'，是鲁迅最孤独最深刻的文字。

books.title: 茶馆
books.author: 老舍
books.desc: 裕泰茶馆五十年兴衰，三幕话剧。一个茶馆看尽三个时代的变迁，'莫谈国事'四个字道尽乱世辛酸。

books.title: 湘行散记
books.author: 沈从文
books.desc: 沈从文回湘西途中写下的游记散文，十二个篇章。沅水流域的水手、妓女、兵士，构成一幅鲜活的湘西风情画。

books.title: 人·兽·鬼
books.author: 钱钟书
books.desc: 钱钟书短篇小说集，收录《上帝的梦》《猫》《灵感》《纪念》四篇。讽刺与机智并存，是钱钟书小说艺术的另一面向。

books.title: 写在人生边上
books.author: 钱钟书
books.desc: 钱钟书第一本散文集，十篇哲理散文。'人生据说是一部大书'，钱钟书以博喻和反讽写透人情世态。

books.title: 金锁记
books.author: 张爱玲
books.desc: 曹七巧被黄金枷锁压垮一生的故事。张爱玲笔下最惨烈的女性悲剧，'三十年来她戴着黄金的枷，她用那沉重的枷角劈杀了几个人'。

books.title: 倾城之恋
books.author: 张爱玲
books.desc: 白流苏与范柳原在香港沦陷中的爱情。一座城市的倾覆成就了一对凡人的姻缘，张爱玲最雅俗共赏的中篇。

books.title: 半生缘
books.author: 张爱玲
books.desc: 沈世钧与顾曼桢被时代和命运拆散的爱情。'我们回不去了'，张爱玲最令人心碎的长篇。

books.title: 红玫瑰与白玫瑰
books.author: 张爱玲
books.desc: 振保生命中的两个女人——红玫瑰热烈奔放，白玫瑰温婉无趣。'娶了红玫瑰，久而久之红的变了墙上的一抹蚊子血'。

books.title: 小团圆
books.author: 张爱玲
books.desc: 张爱玲半自传体长篇小说，遗作出版。九莉与燕山、邵之雍的情感纠葛，是张爱玲对自己一生的清算。

books.title: 色，戒
books.author: 张爱玲
books.desc: 王佳芝刺杀易先生的故事，被李安改编成电影。'到女人心里的路通过阴道'，张爱玲最冷的短篇。

books.title: 呼兰河传
books.author: 萧红
books.desc: 萧红自传体长篇小说，回忆东北小城呼兰河的生活。我与祖父的后花园、大泥坑、小团圆媳妇的悲剧，是萧红最后的杰作。

books.title: 生死场
books.author: 萧红
books.desc: 东北农民在日寇侵略下的苦难与抗争。'死人走在活人中，活人准备着死'，萧红以女性笔触写透生之坚韧与死之漠然。

books.title: 城南旧事
books.author: 林海音
books.desc: 小英子在北京城南的童年回忆：秀贞、妞儿、偷儿、兰姨娘、宋妈。林海音以孩童视角写尽旧北京的人情冷暖。

books.title: 家
books.author: 巴金
books.desc: 高家三兄弟在封建大家庭中的命运挣扎。觉新的懦弱、觉民的反抗、觉慧的出走，是五四青年的精神缩影。

books.title: 春
books.author: 巴金
books.desc: 《家》的续篇，蕙、淑英等年轻女性在封建礼教下的悲剧与反抗。'春天是我们的'，巴金写出了青春的力量。

books.title: 秋
books.author: 巴金
books.desc: 《激流三部曲》终篇，高家彻底衰落。'没有一个完备的团圆'，巴金写尽封建大家庭的必然崩溃。

books.title: 寒夜
books.author: 巴金
books.desc: 抗战后期重庆，小公务员汪文宣在婆媳矛盾和贫病交加中死去。巴金最现实主义的杰作，写尽小人物的辛酸。

books.title: 子夜
books.author: 茅盾
books.desc: 民族资本家吴荪甫在十里洋场的兴衰。茅盾以社会科学家的笔触，全景式展现1930年代中国都市的经济与阶级。

books.title: 林家铺子
books.author: 茅盾
books.desc: 小商人林老板在帝国主义和官僚资本压迫下破产的故事。茅盾最精炼的中篇，写尽30年代民族商业的困境。

books.title: 雷雨
books.author: 曹禺
books.desc: 周鲁两家三十年间的恩怨情仇，一天之内爆发。曹禺的处女作，中国现代话剧成熟的标志。

books.title: 日出
books.author: 曹禺
books.desc: 陈白露在交际花生活中的挣扎与毁灭。'太阳出来了，黑暗留在后面，但是太阳不是我们的'，曹禺写尽都市腐烂。

books.title: 原野
books.author: 曹禺
books.desc: 仇虎从逃狱到复仇的悲剧。曹禺最原始野性的剧作，融合表现主义与民间气息。

books.title: 北京人
books.author: 曹禺
books.desc: 曾家三代在衰败中挣扎。曹禺最后一部杰作，'要走，要走到远远的地方去'。

books.title: 梦里花落知多少
books.author: 三毛
books.desc: 荷西去世后三毛的悲痛与思念。'花落花飞飞满天，红消香断有谁怜'，是三毛最心碎的作品。

books.title: 送你一匹马
books.author: 三毛
books.desc: 三毛与读者的书信和散文。'书中Margarita有一个好父亲'，温柔真挚。

books.title: 万水千山走遍
books.author: 三毛
books.desc: 三毛中南美洲旅行记。墨西哥、危地马拉、厄瓜多尔、秘鲁，三毛眼中的拉丁美洲。

books.title: 我的宝贝
books.author: 三毛
books.desc: 三毛收藏的各种小物件的故事。铜钱、旧衣架、小石像，每件宝贝都有一段回忆。

books.title: 滚滚红尘
books.author: 三毛
books.desc: 三毛唯一的电影剧本，邵华与能才在乱世中的爱情。被严浩改编成电影，林青霞张曼玉主演。

books.title: 在细雨中呼喊
books.author: 余华
books.desc: 孙光林的童年与少年回忆。余华第一部长篇，'我不再装模作样地拥有很多朋友，而是回到了孤单之中'。

books.title: 现实一种
books.author: 余华
books.desc: 山岗山峰兄弟两家的暴力循环。余华早期最冷酷的中篇，血腥而精准。

books.title: 红高粱家族
books.author: 莫言
books.desc: 高密东北乡，我爷爷我奶奶的抗日传奇。莫言以天马行空的叙事和感官描写，开启了中国文学的新境界。

books.title: 酒国
books.author: 莫言
books.desc: 调查员丁钩儿到酒国市调查吃婴案。莫言最荒诞的讽刺小说。

books.title: 长恨歌
books.author: 王安忆
books.desc: 上海小姐王琦瑶四十年的情与爱。王安忆获茅盾文学奖，'一个女人四十年的情与爱'。

books.title: 繁花
books.author: 金宇澄
books.desc: 上海弄堂里阿宝、沪生、小毛等人的故事。金宇澄获茅盾文学奖，用沪语写就的上海城市史诗。

books.title: 额尔古纳河右岸
books.author: 迟子建
books.desc: 鄂温克族最后一位酋长女人的自述。迟子建获茅盾文学奖，写尽游牧民族的衰落与坚守。

books.title: 世界上所有的夜晚
books.author: 迟子建
books.desc: 丈夫意外去世后，'我'到小镇疗愈，却遇到更多苦难。迟子建最私人也最普世的中篇。

books.title: 秦腔
books.author: 贾平凹
books.desc: 清风街夏天礼、夏天义、夏天智三兄弟的故事。贾平凹获茅盾文学奖，写尽乡村的衰败。

books.title: 废都
books.author: 贾平凹
books.desc: 西京城里庄之蝶等四大名人的情与欲。曾被列为禁书，是贾平凹最具争议的作品。

books.title: 受活
books.author: 阎连科
books.desc: 受庄里残障村民被县领导组织成'绝术团'巡回演出赚钱。阎连科的'黑色祈祷'。

books.title: 我与父辈
books.author: 阎连科
books.desc: 阎连科回忆父亲、伯父、叔父三位父辈。'我从未这样悲伤过'，是阎连科最朴素最动人的作品。

books.title: 日光流年
books.author: 阎连科
books.desc: 三姓村人在四十岁寿命的诅咒下与命运抗争。阎连科的'神话'。

books.title: 一句顶一万句
books.author: 刘震云
books.desc: 杨百成、牛爱国两代人寻找'说得着的人'的故事。刘震云获茅盾文学奖，'一个人的孤独不是孤独，一个人找另一个人的孤独才是孤独'。

books.title: 一地鸡毛
books.author: 刘震云
books.desc: 小林家的白菜、豆腐、单位分房。刘震云写尽小市民的日常琐碎，'一地鸡毛'成了生活的代名词。

books.title: 我不是潘金莲
books.author: 刘震云
books.desc: 李雪莲为纠正一句话告状二十年。刘震云最讽刺的中篇，被冯小刚改编成电影。

books.title: 温故一九四二
books.author: 刘震云
books.desc: 1942年河南大饥荒，三百万人饿死。刘震云的调查体小说，'我想知道我从哪里来'。

books.title: 一日三秋
books.author: 刘震云
books.desc: 梨花和延津人的故事，融合魔幻与现实。刘震云最新长篇，'一日三秋，度日如年'。

books.title: 推拿
books.author: 毕飞宇
books.desc: 沙宗琪推拿中心盲人们的生活与爱情。毕飞宇获茅盾文学奖，'他们的世界也有光'。

books.title: 青衣
books.author: 毕飞宇
books.desc: 筱燕秋与嫦娥角色纠缠一生的故事。毕飞宇写透戏曲演员的痴迷与悲剧。

books.title: 妻妾成群
books.author: 苏童
books.desc: 女学生颂莲嫁入陈府做四姨太，在妻妾争宠中走向疯狂。苏童最著名的中篇，被张艺谋改编为《大红灯笼高高挂》。

books.title: 黄雀记
books.author: 苏童
books.desc: 保润、柳生、仙女三个年轻人二十年间的恩怨。苏童获茅盾文学奖，'黄雀在后'。

books.title: 河岸
books.author: 苏童
books.desc: 少年童下河在枫杨树乡的成长。苏童最自传性的长篇。

books.title: 三体Ⅱ：黑暗森林
books.author: 刘慈欣
books.desc: 宇宙就是一座黑暗森林，每个文明都是带枪的猎人。罗辑建立黑暗森林威慑，与三体文明对峙。刘慈欣的巅峰。

books.title: 三体Ⅲ：死神永生
books.author: 刘慈欣
books.desc: 云天明的三个童话、二维化太阳系、程心与关一帆在小宇宙的结局。三部曲终章，'给岁月以文明，而不是给文明以岁月'。

books.title: 超新星纪元
books.author: 刘慈欣
books.desc: 超新星爆发后所有成年人死去，世界交给孩子。刘慈欣最有想象力的长篇。

books.title: 乡村教师
books.author: 刘慈欣
books.desc: 黄土高原上的乡村教师临终前教给学生的牛顿三大定律，拯救了地球文明。最朴素也最震撼的科幻。

books.title: 朝闻道
books.author: 刘慈欣
books.desc: 科学家们用生命换取宇宙真理。'朝闻道，夕死可矣'，是刘慈欣最动人的短篇。

books.title: 北京折叠
books.author: 郝景芳
books.desc: 北京被分成三个空间，折叠轮换生活。郝景芳获雨果奖中短篇小说奖。

books.title: 两京十五日
books.author: 马伯庸
books.desc: 朱瞻基十五天从南京赶回北京继位。马伯庸最紧凑的历史小说。

books.title: 风起陇西
books.author: 马伯庸
books.desc: 三国时期蜀汉与曹魏的谍战。马伯庸处女作，'间谍就在你身边'。

books.title: 明朝那些事儿
books.author: 当年明月
books.desc: 从1344年朱元璋出生到1644年崇祯自缢，三百年明朝史。当年明月以小说笔法写历史，是最畅销的历史普及读物。

books.title: 国史大纲
books.author: 钱穆
books.desc: 钱穆在抗战流亡中写就的中国通史。'所谓对其本国已往历史略有所知者，尤必附随一种对其本国已往历史之温情与敬意'。

books.title: 近代中国社会的新陈代谢
books.author: 陈旭麓
books.desc: 从鸦片战争到五四运动，中国社会结构的深层变迁。陈旭麓的遗作，近代史研究的典范。

books.title: 天朝的崩溃
books.author: 茅海建
books.publisher: 生活·读书·新知三联书店
books.desc: 鸦片战争再研究，从琦善、林则徐的视角重审战争。茅海建最具颠覆性的近代史著作。

books.title: 万古江河
books.author: 许倬云
books.desc: 从新石器时代到今天，中国文化的发展历程。许倬云以全球视野写中国史。

books.title: 干校六记
books.author: 杨绛
books.publisher: 生活·读书·新知三联书店
books.desc: 杨绛在文革干校的劳动生活。'我双手撑着地，慢慢站起来'，克制冷静中见深情。

books.title: 洗澡
books.author: 杨绛
books.desc: 解放后知识分子思想改造的故事。杨绛最讽刺也最宽容的长篇。

books.title: 傅雷家书
books.author: 傅雷
books.publisher: 生活·读书·新知三联书店
books.desc: 傅雷夫妇给儿子傅聪、傅敏的家信。艺术、做人、家国，是中国父母最真挚的教子书。

books.title: 我与地坛
books.author: 史铁生
books.desc: 史铁生双腿瘫痪后在地坛公园的思考。'死是一件不必急于求成的事，死是一个必然会降临的节日'。

books.title: 病隙碎笔
books.author: 史铁生
books.desc: 史铁生在病痛间隙写下的哲思随笔。关于残疾、爱情、信仰、命运，是中国当代最深刻的散文。

books.title: 务虚笔记
books.author: 史铁生
books.desc: 史铁生第一部长篇，写作与生命的寓言。'我是一个行者，我的路在脚下'。

books.title: 命若琴弦
books.author: 史铁生
books.desc: 盲师徒弹三弦为生，师父说弹断一千根琴弦就能看见光明。史铁生最动人的中篇。

books.title: 爱你就像爱生命
books.author: 王小波
books.desc: 王小波给李银河的情书。'你好哇，李银河'，最浪漫也最真诚的情书。

books.title: 谈美
books.author: 朱光潜
books.desc: 朱光潜给青年的第十三封信。'美是主观的，也是客观的'，中国最好的美学入门书。

books.title: 人间词话
books.author: 王国维
books.desc: 王国维的词学批评。境界说：'古今之成大事业大学问者，必经过三种之境界'。

books.title: 美的历程
books.author: 李泽厚
books.desc: 从远古图腾到明清工艺，中国美学的发展历程。李泽厚最有影响力的美学著作。

books.title: 高效能人士的七个习惯
books.author: 史蒂芬·柯维
books.desc: 积极主动、以终为始、要事第一、双赢思维、知彼解己、统合综效、不断更新。最经典的自我管理。

books.title: 人性的弱点
books.author: 戴尔·卡耐基
books.desc: 如何赢得朋友、影响他人、改变他人。卡耐基的经典，畅销全球近百年。

books.title: 从0到1
books.author: 彼得·蒂尔
books.desc: PayPal创始人彼得·蒂尔的创业哲学。'竞争是留给失败者的'，硅谷创投圣经。

books.title: 激荡三十年
books.author: 吴晓波
books.desc: 1978-2008中国企业的风雨三十年。吴晓波写尽中国企业家的沉浮。

books.title: 梦的解析
books.author: 弗洛伊德
books.desc: 弗洛伊德精神分析学奠基之作。梦是愿望的满足，潜意识理论的起点。

books.title: 爱的艺术
books.author: 弗洛姆
books.desc: 爱是一门艺术，一种能力。'不成熟的爱是因为我需要你所以我爱你，成熟的爱是因为我爱你所以我需要你'。

books.title: 逃避自由
books.author: 弗洛姆
books.desc: 现代人在自由面前的焦虑与逃避。弗洛姆从心理学分析法西斯主义的社会心理根源。

books.title: 幸福之路
books.author: 罗素
books.desc: 罗素写给普通人的幸福指南。避免欲望的过度膨胀，在工作和热情中找到幸福。

books.title: 西方哲学史
books.author: 罗素
books.desc: 从古希腊到现代，西方哲学的发展历程。罗素诺贝尔文学奖获奖作品，文笔优美。

books.title: 鼠疫
books.author: 加缪
books.desc: 奥兰城突发鼠疫，里厄医生和人们在封城中的抗争。在荒诞中选择责任与爱。

books.title: 西西弗神话
books.author: 加缪
books.desc: 推石上山的西西弗是荒诞英雄。'应当想象西西弗是幸福的'。加缪的哲学随笔。

books.title: 存在与虚无
books.author: 萨特
books.publisher: 生活·读书·新知三联书店
books.desc: 萨特存在主义哲学巨著。'存在先于本质'，人被判定为自由。

books.title: 查拉图斯特拉如是说
books.author: 尼采
books.publisher: 生活·读书·新知三联书店
books.desc: 查拉图斯特拉下山向世人传授超人哲学。'上帝死了'，尼采最有文学性的哲学著作。

books.author: 乔治·奥威尔
books.desc: 大洋国温斯顿在老大哥统治下的思想罪。'战争即和平，自由即奴役，无知即力量'。反乌托邦三部曲之首。

books.title: 动物农场
books.author: 乔治·奥威尔
books.desc: 曼纳农场的动物造反推翻人类，却被猪篡夺。'所有动物一律平等，但有些动物比其他动物更加平等'。

books.title: 美丽新世界
books.author: 赫胥黎
books.desc: 福特纪元六三二年的世界，人们被基因和药物驯化。奥威尔警告我们憎恨什么，赫胥黎警告我们爱上什么。

books.title: 群山回唱
books.author: 卡勒德·胡赛尼
books.desc: 兄妹阿卜杜拉和帕丽被分离的故事，跨越六十年三个国家。

books.title: 永别了，武器
books.author: 海明威
books.desc: 亨利中尉与凯瑟琳在一战中的爱情与逃亡。'世界打碎了每一个人，然后许多人在破碎处变得坚强'。

books.title: 丧钟为谁而鸣
books.author: 海明威
books.desc: 罗伯特·乔丹在西班牙内战中炸桥的三天。'没有人是一座孤岛……丧钟为谁而鸣，它为你而鸣'。

books.title: 悲惨世界
books.author: 雨果
books.desc: 冉阿让因偷面包坐十九年牢，后在主教感化下成为善人。雨果最宏大的人道主义杰作。

books.title: 巴黎圣母院
books.author: 雨果
books.desc: 敲钟人卡西莫多与吉普赛女郎爱斯梅拉达在巴黎圣母院的悲剧。雨果的浪漫主义经典。

books.title: 基督山伯爵
books.author: 大仲马
books.desc: 爱德蒙·唐泰斯被陷害入狱十四年后复仇。'等待和希望'，大仲马最畅销的冒险小说。

books.title: 三个火枪手
books.author: 大仲马
books.desc: 达达尼昂与阿托斯、波尔多斯、阿拉密斯的冒险。'人人为我，我为人人'。

books.title: 茶花女
books.author: 小仲马
books.desc: 玛格丽特与阿尔芒的爱情悲剧。小仲马根据自己与玛丽·杜普莱西的经历写成。

books.title: 复活
books.author: 列夫·托尔斯泰
books.desc: 聂赫留朵夫在法庭上见到被自己始乱终弃的玛丝洛娃，开始灵魂救赎。托尔斯泰最后的长篇。

books.title: 卡拉马佐夫兄弟
books.author: 陀思妥耶夫斯基
books.desc: 老卡拉马佐夫被杀，四个儿子各怀鬼胎。陀思妥耶夫斯基最后的杰作，宗教大法官的篇章震撼人心。

books.title: 白痴
books.author: 陀思妥耶夫斯基
books.desc: 梅诗金公爵纯洁如白痴，却在彼得堡的世俗中被摧毁。

books.title: 变形记
books.author: 卡夫卡
books.desc: 格里高尔一天早上变成了大甲虫。'一天早晨，格里高尔·萨姆沙从不安的睡梦中醒来，发现自己躺在床上变成了一只巨大的甲虫'。

books.title: 审判
books.author: 卡夫卡
books.desc: 约瑟夫·K在三十岁生日那天被捕，却不知道自己犯了什么罪。

books.title: 城堡
books.author: 卡夫卡
books.desc: K大雪中来到城堡下的村庄，永远无法进入城堡。

books.title: 尤利西斯
books.author: 乔伊斯
books.desc: 布卢姆在都柏林一天的漫游，对应荷马史诗奥德赛。意识流文学的巅峰。

books.title: 不能承受的生命之轻
books.author: 米兰·昆德拉
books.desc: 托马斯、特蕾莎、萨宾娜在布拉格之春前后的爱与命运。'永恒轮回是一种神秘的想法……最沉重的负担同时也成了最强盛的生命力的影像'。

books.title: 玩笑
books.author: 米兰·昆德拉
books.desc: 路德维克因为一张玩笑的明信片毁了一生。昆德拉第一部小说。

books.title: 没有人给他写信的上校
books.author: 加西亚·马尔克斯
books.desc: 上校每天等退休金等了五十六年。'吃什么？''吃屎'。马尔克斯最苦涩的中篇。

books.title: 雪国
books.author: 川端康成
books.desc: 岛村三赴雪国与驹子、叶子的情缘。'穿过县界长长的隧道，便是雪国'。川端康成诺贝尔文学奖代表作。

books.title: 千只鹤
books.author: 川端康成
books.desc: 菊治与太田夫人、文子的情感纠葛。川端康成最美的中篇。

books.title: 古都
books.author: 川端康成
books.desc: 千重子在京都的成长，双胞胎苗子的出现。川端康成最后的诺贝尔文学奖作品。

books.title: 海边的卡夫卡
books.author: 村上春树
books.desc: 田村卡夫卡十五岁离家出走，中田老人奇妙的旅程。村上春树最奇幻的长篇。

books.title: 1Q84
books.author: 村上春树
books.desc: 青豆和天吾在1984年的平行世界里相遇。村上春树最 ambitious 的长篇。

books.title: 刺杀骑士团长
books.author: 村上春树
books.desc: 免色先生、雨田具彦的画、白色斯巴鲁。村上春树最新长篇。

books.title: 且听风吟
books.author: 村上春树
books.desc: 村上春树处女作，'我'在夏天的回忆。'不存在十全十美的文章，如同不存在彻头彻尾的绝望'。

books.title: 舞！舞！舞！
books.author: 村上春树
books.desc: 五反田雪、羊男、宾馆。村上春树最迷幻的长篇。

books.title: 秘密
books.author: 东野圭吾
books.desc: 妻子直子在车祸中灵魂进入女儿藻奈美的身体。东野圭吾最催泪的设定。

books.title: 麒麟之翼
books.author: 东野圭吾
books.desc: 加贺恭一郎在麒麟雕像下调查杀人案。

books.title: 祈祷落幕时
books.author: 东野圭吾
books.desc: 加贺恭一郎的母亲失踪案与杀人案。

books.title: 流星之绊
books.author: 东野圭吾
books.desc: 三兄妹父母被杀，十四年追查凶手。

books.title: 信
books.author: 东野圭吾
books.desc: 杀人犯的弟弟在社会歧视中挣扎。东野圭吾最社会派的小说。

books.title: 时生
books.author: 东野圭吾
books.desc: 时生穿越回二十年前和父亲一起。'时生，我在花屋敷等你'。

books.title: 聊斋志异
books.author: 蒲松龄
books.desc: 蒲松龄写鬼写妖高人一等，刺贪刺虐入木三分。聂小倩、画皮、婴宁。

books.title: 儒林外史
books.author: 吴敬梓
books.desc: 范进中举、严监生临死灯盏点两茎灯草。吴敬梓讽刺科举制度的长篇。

books.title: 封神演义
books.author: 许仲琳
books.desc: 武王伐纣，姜子牙封神。哪吒、杨戬、妲己。

books.title: 镜花缘
books.author: 李汝珍
books.desc: 唐敖游历海外各国。李汝珍最有想象力的古典小说。

books.title: 论语
books.author: 孔子弟子
books.desc: 孔子及其弟子言行录。'学而时习之，不亦说乎''己所不欲，勿施于人'。

books.title: 道德经
books.author: 老子
books.desc: 老子五千言。'道可道，非常道''上善若水，水善利万物而不争'。

books.title: 庄子
books.author: 庄周
books.desc: 庄周梦蝶、逍遥游、齐物论。'吾生也有涯，而知也无涯'。

books.title: 孙子兵法
books.author: 孙武
books.desc: 孙武十三篇兵书。'知己知彼，百战不殆''兵者，诡道也'。

books.title: 曾国藩家书
books.author: 曾国藩
books.desc: 曾国藩给家人的书信。修身、齐家、治国，'结硬寨，打呆仗'。

books.title: 一个人的朝圣
books.author: 蕾秋·乔伊斯
books.desc: 哈罗德徒步六百二十七英里去看狱中老友奎妮。一封来信、一个信念，他走过了英格兰，也走回了自己的内心。

books.title: 素食者
books.author: 韩江
books.desc: 英慧突然开始拒绝吃肉，家人从困惑到暴力，她一步步退向植物般的沉默。韩江布克国际文学奖获奖作。

books.title: 诗经
books.author: 佚名
books.desc: 中国最早的诗歌总集，三百零五篇。关关雎鸠、蒹葭苍苍、青青子衿，两千五百年前的风、雅、颂。

books.title: 菜根谭
books.author: 洪应明
books.desc: 明代洪应明著语录体散文集。'宠辱不惊，闲看庭前花开花落；去留无意，漫随天外云卷云舒'。

books.title: 瓦尔登湖
books.author: 亨利·戴维·梭罗
books.desc: 梭罗在瓦尔登湖畔独居两年的记录。'我步入丛林，因为我希望活得有意义'。超验主义经典。

books.title: 克林索尔的最后夏天
books.author: 赫尔曼·黑塞
books.desc: 黑塞在一战后的混乱中写成的自传式随笔。绘画、醉酒、青春、死亡，语言如迷幻诗。

books.title: 德米安
books.author: 赫尔曼·黑塞
books.desc: 少年辛克莱在德米安引导下寻找自我。'鸟要挣脱出壳。蛋就是世界。人要诞于世上，就得摧毁整个世界'。

books.title: 在轮下
books.author: 赫尔曼·黑塞
books.desc: 汉斯考入神学院却在教育机器压迫下崩溃。黑塞对应试教育的控诉。

books.title: 月亮和六便士
books.author: 威廉·毛姆
books.desc: 银行家思特里克兰德突然弃家出走，去塔希提画画至死。'满地都是六便士，他却抬头看见了月亮'。

books.title: 人性的枷锁
books.author: 威廉·毛姆
books.desc: 菲利普从童年到中年的成长，跛足、爱情、欲望、枷锁。毛姆半自传体长篇。

books.title: 理智与情感
books.author: 简·奥斯汀
books.desc: 达什伍德家两姐妹，埃莉诺理智、玛丽安热情。奥斯汀第一部出版的小说。

books.title: 爱玛
books.author: 简·奥斯汀
books.desc: 爱玛爱做媒，最后发现自己的归宿。奥斯汀最成熟的喜剧。

books.title: 劝导
books.author: 简·奥斯汀
books.desc: 安妮年轻时听从劝导拒绝了温特沃思，八年后他衣锦归来。奥斯汀最后一部小说。

books.title: 简·爱
books.author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
books.desc: 孤女简·爱与罗切斯特的爱情。'你以为我贫穷、低微、不美、矮小，我就没有灵魂没有心吗？'

books.title: 双城记
books.author: 查尔斯·狄更斯
books.desc: 伦敦与巴黎，梅尼特医生、代尔纳、卡尔顿在大革命中的命运。'这是最好的时代，这是最坏的时代'。

books.title: 远大前程
books.author: 查尔斯·狄更斯
books.desc: 匹普从铁匠学徒到伦敦绅士的成长与幻灭。狄更斯晚期最成熟的作品。

books.title: 雾都孤儿
books.author: 查尔斯·狄更斯
books.desc: 奥利弗在济贫院、贼窝中的挣扎。狄更斯第一部社会批判小说。

books.title: 大卫·科波菲尔
books.author: 查尔斯·狄更斯
books.desc: 大卫从孤儿到作家的成长。狄更斯自称'最宠爱的孩子'，半自传体。

books.title: 德伯家的苔丝
books.author: 托马斯·哈代
books.desc: 苔丝被亚雷玷污、被克莱抛弃，最后走向毁灭。'一个纯洁的女人'。

books.title: 无名的裘德
books.author: 托马斯·哈代
books.desc: 裘德想上大学却被阶级门槛挡在外面，与淑的爱情也不被容。哈代最悲剧的长篇。

books.title: 达洛维夫人
books.author: 弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫
books.desc: 克拉丽莎·达洛维一天的伦敦街头。'她自己就是那个时刻，那个顶点'。意识流经典。

books.title: 到灯塔去
books.author: 弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫
books.desc: 拉姆齐一家在苏格兰岛十年间的变化。窗、时光流逝、灯塔，三部曲结构。

books.title: 一间自己的房间
books.author: 弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫
books.desc: '女人要想写小说，必须有钱，再加一间自己的房间'。女性主义经典。

books.title: 金阁寺
books.author: 三岛由纪夫
books.desc: 沟口因金阁的美而纵火焚毁它。三岛根据真实事件写成，美与毁灭的极致。

books.title: 潮骚
books.author: 三岛由纪夫
books.desc: 渔村青年新治与宫田初江的纯洁爱情。三岛最阳光的小说。

books.title: 假面的告白
books.author: 三岛由纪夫
books.desc: 三岛半自传体，写一个青年对死亡、肉体、美的迷恋。成名作。

books.title: 斜阳
books.author: 太宰治
books.desc: 津田蔷薇一家在战后的没落。'斜阳族'一词由此而来。

books.title: 我是猫
books.author: 夏目漱石
books.desc: 以猫的视角观察苦沙弥先生和他的知识分子朋友。夏目漱石成名作，讽刺幽默。

books.title: 心
books.author: 夏目漱石
books.desc: 先生在朋友死后留下遗书，揭示自己的原罪。'人世间再没有像寂寞这样可怕的病了'。

books.title: 伊豆的舞女
books.author: 川端康成
books.desc: '我'在伊豆路上遇到巡回艺人，与舞女薰子的朦胧情愫。川端康成成名作。

books.title: 罗生门
books.author: 芥川龙之介
books.desc: 收录《罗生门》《竹林中》《鼻子》《杜子春》等。黑泽明《罗生门》原作。

books.title: 源氏物语
books.author: 紫式部
books.desc: 光源氏一生的情爱与命运。日本平安时代紫式部写就，世界最早的长篇小说。

books.title: 枕草子
books.author: 清少纳言
books.desc: 清少纳言在宫中的随笔。'春，黎明的时候最有意思'。与《源氏物语》并称平安文学双璧。

books.title: 银河铁道之夜
books.author: 宫泽贤治
books.desc: 乔万尼在银河中与康帕内拉坐火车旅行。宫泽贤治最美的童话，'真正的幸福是什么'。

books.title: 厨房
books.author: 吉本芭娜娜
books.desc: 樱井在厨房中治愈丧亲之痛。吉本芭娜娜成名作，日本当代治愈系小说。

books.title: 失乐园
books.author: 渡边淳一
books.desc: 久木与凛子在不伦之恋中走向殉情。渡边淳一最轰动的小说。

books.title: 沉默
books.author: 远藤周作
books.desc: 葡萄牙神父罗德里格斯在日本幕府迫害下的信仰挣扎。远藤周作代表作，'沉默的上帝'。

books.title: 小径分岔的花园
books.author: 豪尔赫·路易斯·博尔赫斯
books.desc: 间谍余准在花园中传递情报，时间像迷宫一样分岔。博尔赫斯最著名的短篇。

books.title: 阿莱夫
books.author: 豪尔赫·路易斯·博尔赫斯
books.desc: 阿莱夫是空间中包含一切点的点。博尔赫斯短篇小说集。

books.title: 看不见的城市
books.author: 伊塔洛·卡尔维诺
books.desc: 马可·波罗向忽必烈汗描述五十五座城市。'城市就像一块海绵，吸汲着这些不断涌流的记忆的潮水'。

books.title: 如果在冬夜，一个旅人
books.author: 伊塔洛·卡尔维诺
books.desc: 十个小说开头，一个读者在追寻完整的书。卡尔维诺最元小说的作品。

books.title: 玫瑰的名字
books.author: 安伯托·艾柯
books.desc: 中世纪修道院里连环谋杀。艾柯的博学侦探小说，符号学与神学的迷宫。

books.title: 在路上
books.author: 杰克·凯鲁亚克
books.desc: 萨尔与迪安横穿美国的公路旅行。'真正的人都是疯疯癫癫的，他们热爱生活'。垮掉的一代圣经。

books.title: 达摩流浪者
books.author: 杰克·凯鲁亚克
books.desc: 雷在加州山林中寻访禅道。'永远年轻，永远热泪盈眶'。

books.title: 宠儿
books.author: 托妮·莫里森
books.desc: 赛丝在俄亥俄州自由州被亡女'宠儿'鬼魂纠缠。莫里森诺贝尔文学奖代表作。

books.title: 使女的故事
books.author: 玛格丽特·阿特伍德
books.desc: 基列国中，奥芙弗雷德作为使女被征用生育。反乌托邦经典，被改编为热门剧集。

books.title: 逃离
books.author: 艾丽丝·门罗
books.desc: 八个女人逃离又回归的故事。门罗布克国际奖、诺贝尔文学奖代表作。

books.title: 心是孤独的猎手
books.author: 卡森·麦卡勒斯
books.desc: 小镇上，哑巴辛格被各怀心事的人当作倾诉对象。'心是孤独的猎手'。

books.title: 伤心咖啡馆之歌
books.author: 卡森·麦卡勒斯
books.desc: 爱密利亚小姐与李蒙表哥、马文·马西的三角怪恋。麦卡勒斯最著名的中篇。

books.title: 蒂凡尼的早餐
books.author: 杜鲁门·卡波蒂
books.desc: 霍莉·戈莱特利在纽约上流社会游走。'蒂凡尼是个让我不再害怕的地方'。

books.title: 冷血
books.author: 杜鲁门·卡波蒂
books.desc: 堪萨斯州农场四口被杀案，卡波蒂六年追踪凶手。'非虚构小说'开山之作。

books.title: 蝇王
books.author: 威廉·戈尔丁
books.desc: 一群男孩流落荒岛，从文明走向野蛮。戈尔丁诺贝尔文学奖代表作。

books.title: 巴黎伦敦落魄记
books.author: 乔治·奥威尔
books.desc: 奥威尔在巴黎做洗碗工、在伦敦流浪的经历。'贫穷的本质是磨灭未来'。

books.title: 向加泰罗尼亚致敬
books.author: 乔治·奥威尔
books.desc: 奥威尔参加西班牙内战的经历。'我那时才知道，左派报纸的谎言比右派还离谱'。

books.title: 给青年诗人的信
books.author: 莱内·马利亚·里尔克
books.desc: 里尔克给青年卡卜斯的十封信。'要对你心里所有还未解决的事有耐心'。

books.title: 恶心
books.author: 让-保罗·萨特
books.desc: 洛根丁在公园中突然感受到存在的荒谬。萨特存在主义小说代表作。

books.title: 生活在别处
books.author: 米兰·昆德拉
books.desc: 诗人雅罗米尔在青春与革命中的狂热与死亡。昆德拉获梅迪西奖。

books.title: 不朽
books.author: 米兰·昆德拉
books.desc: 阿涅丝、保罗、勃朗-生的三段爱情与不朽。昆德拉最哲学的小说。

books.title: 哈扎尔辞典
books.author: 米洛拉德·帕维奇
books.desc: 一部关于哈扎尔人改宗之谜的辞典小说，阴本阳本。'这是一部十万个读者会读出十万种读法的书'。

books.title: 佩德罗·巴拉莫
books.author: 胡安·鲁尔福
books.desc: 胡安赴科马拉寻父，发现全村都是幽灵。魔幻现实主义先驱，影响了马尔克斯。

books.title: 纸牌的秘密
books.author: 乔斯坦·贾德
books.desc: 汉密士在欧洲旅途中遇到一本神秘的圆顶纸牌故事。贾德继《苏菲的世界》后又一哲思童话。

books.title: 乔布斯传
books.author: 沃尔特·艾萨克森
books.desc: 乔布斯授权官方传记。从里德学院到苹果、皮克斯、回归，一个完美主义者的一生。

books.title: 崩溃
books.author: 贾雷德·戴蒙德
books.desc: 社会为何崩溃？复活节岛、玛雅、格陵兰。戴蒙德续作。

books.title: 昨日的世界
books.author: 斯蒂芬·茨威格
books.desc: 茨威格回忆战前欧洲的黄金时代。'我从来没有比在昨天更热爱欧洲，也从来没有比现在更对它绝望'。

books.title: 一个陌生女人的来信
books.author: 斯蒂芬·茨威格
books.desc: 一个女人用一生爱一个男人，临终写来一封信。茨威格最著名的中篇。

books.title: 人类群星闪耀时
books.author: 斯蒂芬·茨威格
books.publisher: 生活·读书·新知三联书店
books.desc: 十四个改变人类命运的瞬间：滑铁卢、南极探险、列宁封闭列车。茨威格最畅销的历史特写。
